title: 2419. Longest Subarray With Maximum Bitwise AND

examples.explanation: The maximum possible bitwise AND of a subarray is 3. The longest subarray with that value is [3,3], so we return 2.
The maximum possible bitwise AND of a subarray is 4. The longest subarray with that value is [4], so we return 1.
